structured_output.analysis: Only one recipe has been measured so far: iso_3.15, with KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.148 average bits. Its predicted KL was 0.39826, so the single-layer sum underestimates the real loss. The loss is concentrated in MLP layers stored at 2 or 3 bits. The cheapest fix in the per-layer tables is model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj, which drops from 0.00633 with rht_gptq_int2 [E4c3f9b73e065] to 0.00181 with rht_gptq_int3 [E90bd4b2f3645]. Paying for that upgrade means downgrading some other layer, and no per-layer evidence identifies a cheap one. So this round only changes options that do not affect stored bits: act_order (a GPTQ setting that changes the order columns are processed) and damp, applied to the GPTQ-family methods. These cannot be refused on budget. The per-layer method assignment is left unchanged because within each bit width it already uses the lowest-KL variant for the top layers (for example gptq_int3 0.00572 vs rht_gptq_int3 0.00774 on 27.up_proj).

proposals.name: iso315_actorder
proposals.rationale: Turns on weight_algo.act_order=true for all GPTQ-family methods. This leaves stored bits unchanged, so it stays at the 3.148 average bits of iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). It targets the GPTQ-quantized layers where the loss concentrates, for example 27.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065].

proposals.name: iso315_actorder_damp05
proposals.rationale: Uses act_order=true plus a stronger damp=0.05 at the same bits as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). The goal is a more robust Hessian for layers with heavy-tailed activations, such as 27.up_proj with activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a], where gptq_int3 measures 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded].

proposals.name: iso315_rht_actorder
proposals.rationale: Turns on act_order=true only for the rht_gptq variants, which hold 167 of the layers in iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]). Bits are unchanged. Comparing this with the all-GPTQ version separates the effect on rht layers, such as 3.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] and 18.gate_proj with rht_gptq_int2 [Eb1dd74cd6447].
